mentions.name: Carbon dioxide removal
mentions.description: This project works on reversing climate change through carbon dioxide removal, and also explores short-term mechanisms to prevent damage from high temperatures, such as the cloud brightening project over the Great Barrier Reef.
mentions.problem: Reversing climate change and preventing short-term damage from high temperatures.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on reversing climate change. Carbon dioxide removal.

Also getting curious about mechanisms to prevent damage from high temperatures in the short term. There's a project over the Great Barrier Reef I've been digging into what mechanisms they're using: https://barrierreef.org/news/explainers/what-is-cloud-brightening
mentions.author: tito
